'''Greater Banishment''' is a [[spell]].  It first appeared in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Casting Modifier''': -2

'''Sanity Cost''': 2

'''Upkeep Phase''': You may cast and discard to choose one [[dimensional symbol]] other than the moon.  All [[monster]]s with that symbol are returned to the [[Monster_cup|monster cup]].
